enPunto.title: En Punto
enPunto.body: En Punto is the independent watch fair. Lugworthy is its year-round directory: the brands you meet at the fair, measured to the millimeter.

forBrands.title: For brands
forBrands.intro: Your page on Lugworthy already exists, built from your public store. Claim it to take control.
forBrands.b1: Your photos, logo, banner and colors on your page.
forBrands.b2: Confirmed specs with a Verified badge, so shoppers trust the numbers.
forBrands.b3: Daily sync from Shopify, with changes to confirmed fields waiting for your approval.
forBrands.b4: Buy buttons that go straight to your store, with your affiliate program if you run one.
forBrands.imagePolicy: We never show your images until you grant a license. You can revoke it any time; images come down within an hour.
forBrands.h1: Email from your website’s domain (magic link), or
forBrands.h2: A meta tag on your homepage, or a DNS TXT record, or
forBrands.h3: Manual approval if we met at En Punto.
forBrands.formNote: Claiming opens with brand accounts. Leave your work email and we’ll send your invite link.
forBrands.sent: Thanks. We’ll email {email} with your claim link.

common.notFoundBody: It may have moved, or the brand hasn’t published it.
